title_en: In the Courtroom (2/20): The Neighbors' Boundary
note_en: Notice 把 in 陈先生请了工人，把围墙按照测量员画出的边界线重新砌好: the object (围墙 "the wall") is pulled in front of the verb, and the sentence then says what was done to it and with what result (重新砌好 "rebuilt properly"). English simply says "rebuilt the wall"; Chinese uses 把 when the focus is on how a definite object is handled or changed, so the verb can't stand bare and needs a result or complement after it.
